name: VIM-MathVista
description: A multimodal benchmark of visually grounded math problems that evaluates models' ability to reason about and solve math problems presented with images and accompanying text. It measures arithmetic, symbolic reasoning, and diagram/figure interpretation in contexts requiring integration of visual and textual information.
reputation: A recent dataset from the VIM-Bench suite gaining attention for assessing multimodal mathematical reasoning, especially for vision+language models.
